verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent-observability SaaS with a CLI and APIs, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair axis to judge it on. The pack has no evidence of versioned API endpoints or any documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. The versioning that is mentioned covers users' prompts, skills, and model changes, which is an adjacent feature rather than API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
